newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hotel Grand Central to sell NZ property.
newsitem.headline: Hotel Grand Central to sell NZ property.

text.p: Hotel Grand Central Ltd said on Thursday its wholly owned subsidiary, Grand Central (NZ) Ltd, had agreed to sell an Auckland property for New Zealand $10.07 million to CBD New Zealand Ltd or its nominee.
It said in a statement the book value of 80-88 Greys Avenue, Auckland was NZ$7,469,180 and a property consultant had valued it at NZ$9,219,000.

The excess over the book value would be used to reduce bank borrowings and the sale would have no material effect on the earnings per share and net tangible assets per share of Hotel Grand Central, it said.
